subject: paediatrics
title: Neonatal resuscitation and stabilization: NRP steps

steps.tx: **Preparation** (**trained team**, **warmer** preheated, **suction** bulb then catheter, **PPV** device tested, **pulse oximeter** right wrist preductal, **cord clamp** delayed 30 to 60 seconds vigorous) with **initial** (**dry warm stimulate**, **position sniffing**, **clear airway** mouth nose, **tone breathing** assess) starts every birth; **meconium** (vigorous routine, **non-vigorous** tube clears) triages. Apgar scores resuscitation not delays.
steps.say: Dry warm stimulate sniff clear assess tone breathing every birth: meconium vigorous routine floppy tubes. Scores never delay.

steps.tx: **PPV** (**apnoea gasping HR under 100**, **40 to 60 per minute**, **PIP 20 to 25**, **PEEP 5**, **room air term 21 percent**, preterms 21 to 30 percent titrated; **chest rise** watches, **MR SOPA** mask reposition suction open pressure airway) with **CPAP** (laboured spontaneously breathing, grunting) supports; **oxygen** (preductal targets minutes 60 to 65 at 1 min rising to 85 to 95 by 10) titrates blender. Prolonged PPV suctions stomach.
steps.say: Blue limp slow under 100 gets bag mask 40 60 room air: rise fails MR SOPA fixes. Right wrist targets titrate.

vis.alt: Illustration of neonatal PPV showing proper mask seal, chest rise, sniffing position, and monitoring with pulse oximeter and oxygen blender.
vis.caption: Neonatal positive pressure ventilation (PPV) technique and monitoring

steps.tx: **Compressions** (**HR under 60 after 30 seconds effective PPV**, **3 to 1 ratio**, **90 compressions 30 breaths**, **two thumbs** encircling, **depth third** chest, **100 percent oxygen** raised) with **adrenaline** (**HR under 60 after compressions**, **0.01 to 0.03 mg per kg IV** preferred, **ETT 0.05 to 0.1** while access secured, repeat 3 to 5 minutes) and **volume** (**normal saline 10 ml per kg**, pallor poor perfusion bleed) expands; **UVC** (umbilical venous emergency) accesses. Hands encircle thumbs press.
steps.say: Sixty despite good bagging gets thumbs 3 to 1 oxygen up: still slow adrenaline IV tenths. Saline tens pale bleeds.

steps.tx: **Post** (**glucose** hypoglycaemia screens, **temperature** 36.5 to 37.5 servo, **antibiotics** sepsis risk, **HIE** cooling criteria, **transport** warm glucose monitored) with **ethics** (**22 to 25 weeks** parental counselling, **non-initiation** anomalies, **stopping** 20 minutes asystole) closes; **debrief** (team review, records) learns. Golden hour stabilises.
steps.say: Warm sugared screened cooled selected transported monitored: twenty minutes flat stops counselled. Debriefs learn.
